thread:
maya: FYI we received INV-2026-219 from PortoData Consulting Lda (Portugal) for 18,500 EUR. They marked 'Foreign (non-US)' but no W-8 attached. Invoice shows VAT PT123456789 and charges 23% VAT. Do we need a W-8BEN-E for a PT company? Withholding or gross-up? Also should we ask them to reissue without VAT (we're a US buyer)? @sam @owen

marta: :robot_face: Invoice bot: INV-2026-219, 18,500 EUR, date 2026-05-08, bank details present, attachments: none.

owen: Vendor ops: Request W-8BEN-E (entity). Withholding only applies if payment is US-source or services performed in US. Confirm service location. For VAT: as a US buyer we generally aren't VAT-liable; EU vendors commonly zero-rate exports to non-EU B2B. Ask them to reissue without VAT or state VAT 0% (export). I'll contact them.

sam: Legal: If PortoData is an Lda (company) W-8BEN-E is correct (not W-8BEN). No automatic gross-up unless contract states it. If services were physically performed in US, need facts to assess withholding. Request W-8BEN-E + confirmation of service location.

priya: AP: I've placed the invoice on payment hold in NetSuite. Hold note: 'Awaiting W-8BEN-E and VAT clarification from PortoData.' Will not schedule payment until we get reissued invoice without VAT or vendor provides legal justification + tax docs. I'll chase and escalate after 72h.

owen: Draft sent to vendor (2026-05-10T15:12Z): 'Please confirm service location; reissue invoice without VAT or indicate VAT 0% (export); provide completed W-8BEN-E.' CC AP.

maya: Quick Q: do we ever accept EU VAT and reclaim? We don't have EU VAT registration so we can't reclaim, right?

sam: Correct. Without EU VAT registration we can't reclaim EU VAT. Ask vendor to remove VAT. If they insist, ask for legal basis and escalate. No Redwood gross-up unless in contract.

priya: Noted. I'll track vendor response and escalate to tax/legal if they push back. Flags: follow up 48h, escalate 72h.

maya: Thanks — action items documented. Owen to follow up, Priya/AP to keep hold, Sam legal on standby. :white_check_mark:
